title: The co-directional overtaking collision problem between a dispersive shock wave and a rarefaction wave for the Hirota equation
summary: In this paper, we mainly investigate the overtaking collision problem between a dispersive shock wave (DSW) and a rarefaction wave (RW) propagating in the same direction in the defocusing Hirota equation framework. Based on the Whitham theory, the zero-phase and single-phase modulation systems corresponding to the defocusing Hirota equation are given, along with explicit expressions of Riemann invariants.
